styles.name: phoenix-rising
styles.description: Phoenix ascends: flame column grows with progress, wings spread wide and flicker with time

styles.name: dragon-flight
styles.description: Dragon flies left-to-right with a serpentine body and arc of fire breath

styles.name: hydra-heads
styles.description: Hydra: each 10% progress grows a new writhing neck and snapping head

styles.name: kraken-depths
styles.description: Kraken tentacles rise from the abyss, sine-undulating as progress advances

styles.name: pegasus-gallop
styles.description: Pegasus gallops across the bar: legs cycle through a gait, wings beat overhead

styles.name: medusa-gaze
styles.description: Medusa: radial writhing snake-hair strands grow outward from a central head

styles.name: minotaur-labyrinth
styles.description: Labyrinth rings drawn inward ring-by-ring as progress advances; Minotaur pulses at the core

styles.name: icarus-sun
styles.description: Icarus climbs toward the blazing sun; feathers scatter and fall as he nears 100%

styles.name: cerberus-watch
styles.description: Cerberus: three animated dog-heads spread across the bar, jaws barking with time

styles.name: valkyrie-ride
styles.description: Valkyrie charges across on horseback: spear extended, trail of glory behind

styles.name: yggdrasil-grows
styles.description: Yggdrasil world-tree grows trunk, branches, and roots as progress advances

styles.name: ouroboros
styles.description: Ouroboros: a snake traces a circle that closes completely as progress reaches 100%
